status: Existing implementation behavior reproduced; proposed reclamation is unimplemented

result.scope: Prepared candidates use the real source catalog at the exact binary ABI. Refusal, restart, task execution and stop use the actual compiled daemon/CLI. No bundle deletion was attempted.

failedSetup.explanation: Initial source-catalog preparation ran under the workspace cwd while the binary daemon ran under the disposable repository cwd. Bundler path comments changed the content digest, so restoring source did not match a retained bundle. The corrected probe uses the repository cwd for both. The first run is not a passing restoration proof.

limits: Only Darwin ARM64 and the recorded release build were tested.
Candidate preparation uses the actual source catalog; startup refusal, restored startup and task execution use the compiled executable.
No deletion, dependency scanner, journal, corruption recovery or retirement API has been implemented or tested.
All credentials and task data belong to disposable synthetic repositories.
